description: Spacecraft completes initialization and begins nominal mission operations.
Scheduled high-gain antenna downlink begins at 220 kbps.
Battery cell 3 drifts outside the normal balancing band.
Battery cell 3 internal resistance rises and terminal voltage begins an unexpected decline under load.
Battery terminal voltage crosses the 26.2 V warning threshold.
EPS sheds 85 W of non-essential load to protect the main bus.
Battery heater power is cut from 18 W to 8 W during load shedding.
Available power falls below the mission-operations allocation.
Reduced heater and pump power let the thermal loop drift above its setpoint.
Reduced reaction-wheel torque authority pushes attitude error past 0.5 deg.
Transmitter power is reduced from 10.5 W to 7.4 W to preserve the bus.
Flight computer CPU load exceeds 75% while managing the power shortfall.
A marginal bus triggers a flight computer watchdog reset.
The onboard computer enters safe mode and sheds payload and non-essential loads.
Downlink rate falls to 64 kbps and signal-to-noise ratio approaches the critical threshold.
Battery terminal voltage crosses the 24.8 V critical threshold.
Battery temperature crosses the 32 degC warning threshold.
Mission operations declare a mission-level failure because payload downlink cannot be recovered in safe mode.
Safe mode stabilizes at a reduced power state with the battery above its state-of-charge critical limit.
